Dear Miss Yonge	
[I](/person/939) am home again and at work, having greatly enjoyed my holiday.
I hope to see you soon in London.

Will you kindly give us notice when you are coming. I am anxious to see what can be done, if anything in the way of a [vignette](/topic/167) for the “[Dove](/book/62)”.

Yours ever truly
A.

Macmillan
Many thanks for the information you kindly sent [Mr Craik](/person/379)
